lastCompletedStory.title: Recusar arvore vazia na vendorizacao e em verify

nextStoryContext: verify now throws when its recursive source scan is empty, while vendorCoss rejects an empty fetch result before creating staging or the destination. The dedicated regression test also proves the CLI adapter returns non-zero for an empty verification root.

officialDocsValidated.summary: Current existsSync and readdirSync return contracts match the filesystem assertions used by the non-vacuous regression tests.
